motion.name: commit-seal
motion.purpose: Drawn seal length = elapsed share of SD_COMMIT_MS; closing completes the commit (foil sheen fills the band left to right, hub ring clockwise from 12 o'clock).

motion.name: undo-window
motion.purpose: After any commit or pass, the hub (arena) or the bottom bar (Solo) offers ANNULER for 4 s.

seal.name: rule
seal.purpose: Radial arena seams (hub edge to rim), Home focus underline (140px), journal title rule (120px), band edges.

seal.name: band-seal
seal.value: 2-stop foil fill #B9BEC6 → #F3F4F6, x 0 → UI_W × progress, on solid #B9BEC6; 2px edges always complete
seal.purpose: Foil band (Solo, Fiche poison); the bright leading edge is the timer; nothing drawn ahead of the progress (user decision, 2026-11-12).

seal.name: ring-seal
seal.purpose: Hub: closed at rest; while pending drawn to −90° + 360° × progress over SD_COMMIT_MS, on the foil disc.

seal.name: crest
seal.value: solid 6px arc, radius 176px (R−4), inset 6° at each end of the seat span
seal.purpose: Active seat's rim; Wrapper Black on the selected field, Wrapper Ink otherwise. The only stroke heavier than 2px.

geometry.seatOrder: J1 at bottom (90°), then clockwise; sector = 360/n
geometry.labelRotation: per seat: ARGB8888 layer turned by (seat angle − 90°); J1 drawn directly; Solo upright

hub.rest: TOUR n (Label Small, ink) at CY−20 over active J# (Headline Hub, seat hue) at CY+8

components.description: For 4 s after a commit the hub is an ink-inverse disc: ANNULER over the delta it reverses, or J1 › J2 after a pass; tap = undo.

narrative.overview:
The dial is a booster wrapper. Each seat is a saturated wrapper field on a wrapper-interior black ground. A pending change rides a dull silver band that the foil sheen fills from left to right in exactly 800 ms (on the hub, a 2 px ring closes clockwise); when the seal is complete, the change is committed. This one metaphor governs every surface: colour fields, a single foil, and the closing seal as the only ornament and the only progress indicator. Every edge is smooth: the user rejected the zigzag crimp (2026-11-12).

Density is low and the type is loud. Every screen has one huge condensed numeral or title, a single line of uppercase labels, and nothing else. Hierarchy comes from size and field fill, not from tints, shadows or opacity. The build is drawn in code (LVGL 9 draw calls into one full-screen object), so the system consists of flat fills, 2 px lines, filled triangles, one horizontal foil gradient and two TTF faces; in the arena each seat is drawn into its own layer and turned to face its player. The dial is round (360×360) and every layout is centred on (180, 180).

Rejected (from the contract): the default life-counter look of a black dial, a white number, a thin progress ring and rainbow quadrants. Also rejected by the product record: any copy of Soul Dial branding, and any Wizards of the Coast logos, mana symbols or card art.
keyCharacteristics: A strict tonal set: ground, ink, four seat hues, foil. No tints, no alpha fades.
Straight 2 px rules mark every seam, focus and the band edges; the seal is the foil sheen filling the band, or the hub ring closing, in step with the commit. No zigzag anywhere.
One rule weight (2 px) for every line, outline, ring and arc; the 6 px active-seat crest is the single exception.
Condensed ExtraBold numerals and SemiBold uppercase labels, kerning off.
The foil gradient appears only while something is pending.
A seat is never identified by hue alone: every seat carries its J1–J4 label.
Every arena seat faces its player; the hub at the centre is the turn marker, the undo pill and the pending seal.

rules.name: The Seat Owns Its Hue Rule
rules.body: Seat hues mark seats only: fields, numerals, the J-labels, the active seat's J# in the resting hub, home seat chips and the 14 px seat swatch in the log. Chrome (buttons, menu focus, focus marks, the undo pill, the active-seat crest) is never drawn in a seat hue.

rules.name: The One Foil Rule
rules.body: The foil is the only gradient in the system, and it shows only while a delta is pending: the Solo and Fiche bands and the pending hub. When nothing is pending, no foil is on screen.

rules.name: The No Fade Rule
rules.body: Everything is drawn at full opacity. Defeat, inactivity and secondary state are shown by dropping the field fill, or (defeat) by the skull mark in full seat hue in place of the total, never by lowering alpha.

rules.name: The Real Minus Rule
rules.body: Negative deltas use U+2212 (−), not a hyphen. Positive deltas always show "+".

rules.name: The All Caps Rule
rules.body: Every label and row is uppercase French, taken from ui/strings_fr.h. Beyond letters and numerals, text carries only signed deltas and the separators "·", "=", "/" and "›".

rules.name: The Drawn Pointer Rule
rules.body: In text rows (journal, menu, undo pill) a hand-off or attack is written with U+203A as the separator ("J3 › J1"). In the pending hub the pointer is a drawn filled triangle between the two J#, never a glyph. The +/− beside a selected total are drawn 2 px marks (18 px), never glyphs.

rules.name: The Seats Face Their Players Rule
rules.body: An arena seat's numeral, label, +/− marks and tap zones all live in that seat's frame, turned by (seat angle − 90°), with the label on the rim side. Never lay out a seat element in screen coordinates.

rules.name: The Rule Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate planes with a straight seam in the rule weight. Never use a drop shadow or an offset.

rules.name: The No Zigzag Rule
rules.body: The user rejected the jagged look (2026-11-12). No zigzag, toothed, serrated or crimped edge on any line, seam, ring, band or crest. Every seal is a smooth form whose drawn extent is the progress: the foil fill across the band, the arc on the hub.

rules.name: The One Rule Weight Rule
rules.body: 2 px everywhere. No hairlines and no heavier strokes. The one exception is the active-seat crest, a solid 6 px arc.

rules.name: The Hub-Only Repaint Rule
rules.body: Arena seats show committed values. While only the pending value, the seal or the pill changes, invalidate the hub box (radius 48 + 6 px) and never the turned seat layers.

dos: Do fill the selected seat, and only the selected seat, with its hue. Draw all other totals in their hue on Wrapper Black.
Do draw every edge, seam and focus mark as a straight 2 px rule (or a 2 px arc on the hub).
Do show pending state on foil, with the seal (band fill or hub arc) equal to the elapsed share of the commit time (800 ms, linear), and nothing drawn ahead of it.
Do pair every seat hue with its J1–J4 label.
Do use ink-inverse fills (or the field's own text colour on a seat field) for primary actions and focus; the hub undo pill and the Solo undo bar are always Wrapper Ink.
Do take every user-facing string from ui/strings_fr.h, in uppercase.
Do draw each arena seat in its own frame, turned by (seat angle − 90°), with the label on the rim side.
Do keep the hub the single place for turn, undo and pending state; repaint only the hub while only it changes.
donts: Don't use a seat hue for chrome, buttons, menu focus, the undo pill or the crest.
Don't add a second gradient, or show foil when nothing is pending.
Don't fade, dim or lower the opacity of a defeated or inactive seat. Replace a defeated total with the skull mark in full hue.
Don't draw a zigzag, toothed or crimped edge anywhere; the user rejected it.
Don't add shadows, glows or offset depth.
Don't use strokes other than 2 px, except the 6 px active-seat crest.
Don't use a hyphen for minus, or a glyph for the hub pointer or the +/− marks.
Don't fall back to the category default (black dial, white number, thin progress ring, rainbow quadrants), and don't copy Soul Dial branding or use WotC marks, mana symbols or card art.
